welcome.hello: Hello! Your server's history is ready to be logged.
welcome.intro: Before you start, let's set up a few things.

purge.title: How long should Tracel keep history?
purge.explain: Tracel automatically removes old history to keep the database under control. Each kind has its own time. You can change this later.

entities.explain: How many entities can a rollback restore? Tracel will ask for confirmation when this limit is exceeded.
entities.label: Entity confirmation limit

radius.explain: Prevent radius-based rollbacks from affecting areas larger than this, in blocks.
radius.label: Maximum scope radius

logging.title: What should Tracel log?
logging.explain: Logging everything gives you the most complete history, but uses more storage.

damage.label: Entity damage <gray>(every blow a mob survives)</gray>

migrate.title: CoreProtect found
migrate.found: Tracel found CoreProtect's database on this server.
migrate.explain: Bring its history over now? CoreProtect's data is only read and never changed. You can also do it later with "/tracel data migrate coreprotect".

done.config: You can always change this in the config file.
done.restart: Restart the server to save your choices.

common.busy: Another job is running... Wait for it to finish
common.no_permission: You don't have permission to use this command
common.invalid: <token> is not a valid argument — see suggestions to see what is allowed

next.confirm: <gray>Next</gray>: to confirm the operation, run it again with #confirm

button.continue_hover: <white>Put the command with #confirm in the chat box</white>
button.backup_hover: <white>Put "/tracel data export" in the chat box</white>

reason.needs_player: a scope around you needs a player — run this in game, or specify a world
reason.other_world: you are not in <world> — a scope around you cannot be used there
reason.too_large: scope is too large — maximum is <blocks> blocks or <chunks> chunks
reason.no_window: the start of the time range is after its end
reason.denied: the server cannot write to the export folder

hint.denied: give the server write access to that folder, then try again
hint.no_space: free up some disk space, then try again
hint.unknown: check the server log for details

help.title: <light_purple>◎ Tracel <version></light_purple>
help.about: <gray>A fast, modern block logging and rollback system</gray>
help.rollback: <gray>/tracel rollback</gray>: roll back / undo world history
help.near: <gray>/tracel near</gray>: what happened around you in the last minutes
help.player: <gray>/tracel player</gray>: what a player did, on one screen
help.preset: <gray>/tracel preset</gray>: save lookup / rollback options as a preset
help.data: <gray>/tracel data</gray>: export, import, migrate or purge the database
help.status: <gray>/tracel status</gray>: how the plugin is doing

lookup.headline: <aqua>☰ Lookup results, page <page>/<total></aqua>
lookup.title: <gray><verb> <n> <n:time:times></gray>: <white>first <first>, last <last></white>
lookup.no_search: No search to turn pages in
lookup.not_flushed: Some captures had not finished being written — this page may be missing the last moment

hint.again: again in a moment, or check the server can reach the paste server from the config
a shorter time range or a smaller scope, or check the server log for details

inspect.players_only: Only players can toggle inspect mode
inspect.on: Inspector mode on. Click any block or container to see its history in chat

preview.title: <aqua>☰ Rollback preview</aqua>
preview.ghost: <count> blocks blinking for <seconds>s — only you see them

done.title: <green>✔ Rolled back!</green>
done.nothing: <gray>Result</gray>: nothing changed — the world already matches

rollback.entities: this would bring <count> entities back (<mostly>); that is past the <limit> this server allows in one go

reason.opposites: #blocks and #items are opposites — give one or neither
reason.plan_failed: could not work out what to do — <reason>
reason.stale: the world kept changing under it (<attempts> attempts)
reason.blocked: another rollback is still running on this area

hint.again: again in a moment, or check the server log for details
hint.unreachable: making it reachable again, then run it once more
hint.blocked: again once the other rollback has finished
hint.stale: stopping the redstone or whatever keeps moving these items, then run it again

rollback.imported: <count> imported <count:record:records> left alone — imported history is read-only
rollback.not_flushed: History was still being written after <seconds>s of waiting — what had not landed yet is not in this rollback; run it again in a moment for the rest
rollback.planning: Reading history and planning the rollback — a big area takes a while...

reason.already: that rollback is already taken back
reason.not_found: that rollback is no longer on record
reason.out_of_order: a newer rollback by someone else touched the same blocks or items
reason.nothing: you have no rollback to take back

hint.again: a shorter time range or a smaller scope, or check the server log for details

button.share_hover: <white>Make @<name> a preset of the whole server</white>

reason.bad_name: not a valid name for a preset
reason.add_nested: a preset cannot hold another preset
reason.console: the console has no presets of its own
reason.global_perm: changing the server's presets needs a permission, which you don't have

hint.name: picking another name
hint.add: adding some flags to it first
hint.rename: saving yours under another name, then sharing that

export.stopped: Export stopped, no file was written

confirm.info: this writes a snapshot to disk: up to <size> MiB, <free> MiB free
confirm.low: this needs up to <size> MiB on disk, but only <free> MiB is free

button.file_hover: Copy file path to the clipboard<gray>
button.import_hover: Put the import command in the chat box

import.start: Import started. All current history will be replaced. Please wait...
import.stop: Stopping the import before it touches anything...
import.stopped: Import stopped, the history is as it was
import.too_late: Too late to stop. Should have thought about that earlier

preview.title: <dark_aqua>↓ Import preview</dark_aqua>
preview.scope: this replaces all recorded history with the file; this cannot be undone

reason.missing: the file could not be found
reason.bad_name: the file is not in the export folder

hint.missing: run the command again and pick the file from the suggestions
hint.bad_name: pick a file from the suggestions instead of entering a path

coreprotect.title: <dark_aqua>⇵ CoreProtect migrator</dark_aqua>
coreprotect.scope: CoreProtect and Tracel are fundamentally different, so this import is read-only and cannot be rolled back. Don't worry, CoreProtect's suffering is not part of the migration.
coreprotect.nothing_left: Everything in this database is already imported
coreprotect.stop: Stopping the import after the batch it is on...

reason.no_room: this database was started by a Tracel build that left no room for older history
reason.unreadable: the CoreProtect database could not be read: <reason>

hint.not_found: put CoreProtect's folder, with its config and database, into plugins
hint.no_room: "/tracel data purge all" first, then import again
hint.unreadable: check CoreProtect's config and the server log
hint.paused: running the command again to carry on where it stopped

hover.forward: <white>This server is newer than the newest Minecraft version Tracel was tested on</white>
hover.load: <white>The server tick takes <mspt> ms on average</white>
hover.degraded: <white>Captured history is written <span> late, so lookup may miss the latest changes</white>
hover.low_disk: <white>Only <free> (<percent>%) is left where the database lives</white>
hover.critical_disk: <white>Only <free> (<percent>%) is left where the database lives. If it gets any lower, Tracel will forcibly shut the server down, because there will be nowhere to write history</white>

purge.start: Purging... this can take a while on a big database
purge.waiting: Waiting for a rollback to finish...

hint.unknown: check the server log for details

reason.all_alone: "all" wipes everything and cannot be mixed with filters
reason.containers_player: a container layout is nobody's doing, so it cannot be purged by player

preview.title: <dark_aqua>⇵ Purge preview</dark_aqua>
preview.nothing: Nothing matches these filters, so nothing would go

suggest.category: What to purge: blocks, items, containers, or events
suggest.older: Records older than a time span
suggest.containers: What containers held, and who opened them

hint.no_world: loading that world, then clicking again

command.status: Show how the plugin is doing
command.rollback: Roll back world and container changes
command.undo_confirm: Undo it anyway, past the entity warning
command.near: See what happened around you recently
command.preset: Save lookup and rollback options as a preset; use them as @name
command.preset_list: List your presets and server presets
command.preset_add: Save the current options as a preset
command.preset_share: Make one of your presets the server's own
command.preset_unshare: Take a server preset back as your own
command.data: Export, import, migrate or purge the history database
command.export_confirm: Yes, write the snapshot to disk
command.import: Replace all history with another database
command.import_stop: Stop the running import, while it can still be stopped
command.purge: Delete recorded history, all of it or by filter
command.migrate: Bring in history from another plugin

suggest.scope_block: The block you are standing on
suggest.scope_chunk: The chunk you are standing in

flag.preview: Preview without changing the world or inventory
flag.explosion: Restore the crater and destroyed container contents
flag.strict: Prioritize later changes over rollback accuracy
flag.confirm: Allow entity restores beyond the safety limit
flag.each: Every record on its own line, nothing folded together
flag.natural: Include everything that has happened naturally
flag.all: Everything: all actions, natural changes, etc.
flag.scope: Radius around you: 10 blocks, 2 chunks, etc.
